task: Personalized neoantigen vaccine composition under a manufacturing budget
objective: MinSum — minimize sum over cells of -log P(response_i) under a peptide-budget constraint (budget=10), adaptive variant
inputs: tumor cell populations with presented peptides and HLA
per cell-element response probabilities from pVACtools-style scores (cleavage, MHC binding, pMHC stability)
outputs_required: selected vaccine composition (set of neoantigen elements)
coverage ratio of tumor cells (fraction with p_response above thresholds)
IoU between optimal vaccine compositions across replicates
fidelity_notes: Use the precomputed adaptive MinSum outputs as ground truth; reproduce IoU, coverage, runtime, and per-cell response-probability statistics from those files.
